history.summary: A large 2,024 sqft 4BR freehold in D12 (8 Raja, Whampoa/Serangoon Rd fringe, TOP 2013) at $3.28M / $1,621 PSF. Quantum is well above the $3M liquidity ceiling, the 4.80%/yr rate rests on only 2 URA transactions, and the PSF sits just above the $1,597 median in a niche large-format segment.
history.rating_rationale: At $3.28M this is past the point where the buyer pool thins sharply, and a 2,024 sqft 4BR is a niche large-family product with limited demand and weak rental yield per dollar. The 4.80%/yr appreciation figure is derived from just 2 transactions, so it carries no statistical weight, and the asking $1,621 PSF is already above the $1,597 URA median. Score 463 and a sub-.500 arena record (189-217) reflect the poor risk/reward. Freehold and generous space suit own-stay, but as a 5-7yr investment the quantum, illiquidity and unreliable data make this one to avoid.
red_flags: $3.28M quantum well above the $3M liquidity ceiling — shallow buyer pool
Appreciation from only 2 URA transactions — statistically meaningless
Large 2,024 sqft 4BR is a niche, slow-moving format
Asking PSF above URA median in a thin segment
Low rental yield on a large high-quantum unit
catalysts: Generous 2,024 sqft for the family own-stay buyer
Future Mount Pleasant TEL station ~850m provides long-term connectivity
